newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Minister sees Petrogal-Saudi deal by July.
newsitem.headline: Minister sees Petrogal-Saudi deal by July.

text.p: Negotiations for the world's largest state-owned oil company Saudi Aramco to take a stake in Portugal's Petrogal are entering the final stretch and could be completed by July, Economy Minister Augusto Mateus said on Monday.
"This month or July, I believe (it will be concluded) in the next two months," the minister told journalists after meeting a Saudi delegation.
The head of the Saudi delegation, Sheikh Ismail Abudawood, also expressed optimism that a deal was close. "Definitely. Everybody is working hard for it," he said.
Petrogal is 55 percent controlled by the government, with the remaining 45 percent being in the hands of a Portuguese consortium made up of banks and major companies.
One of the leading private Portuguese investors said recently that a key stumbling block, the evaluation of Petrogal, had been largely overcome with all sides agreed on a price range.
